name: app-oviah-menstrual-cycle-phases-education-cards
title: OVIAH educational slide: the four menstrual cycle phases explained in a 2x2 lilac card grid
whatItIs: A white slide titled 'Different phases in a menstrual cycle' with a 2x2 grid of lilac cards (Menstrual, Follicular, Ovulation, Luteal), each naming its approximate day range, bullet facts and a 'What is happening' explanation.
whatItMeans: Educational and credible; grounding app content in real physiology builds trust before showing any UI.
techniques: Explain domain knowledge before showing the product.
Pair each phase with both facts and a plain-language summary.
Use a consistent card template across all four phases.

vocabulary.definition: Background subject expertise informing a design.
Content arranged in equal rectangular cells.
